life.source: OpenStreetMap transit features; modes are identified by the mapped terminal names. These sites stage simulated local scenes. Traffic signal locations follow project-owner corrections (2026-10-01), including the follow-ups restoring Magsaysay Avenue's junctions on either side of the bridge: Penafrancia/M. T. Villanueva (OSM node 254709879) and Dayangdang/Balatas-Cararayan (OSM node 254713607), and Panganiban Drive at Misericordia/Lerma (OSM node 254716718).

add.source: Project owner follow-up annotated atlas image (2026-10-01): add traffic lights at Elias Angeles Street/Santonja Street beside Naga Metropolitan Cathedral. Position is the shared OSM road vertex of ways 724187422 and 282035194. This adds a third location to the earlier two-junction downtown correction.

Project owner annotated Panganiban Drive atlas images (2026-10-01), image 1 western circle: Blumentritt Street junction east of the bridge. Position is the shared OSM road vertex of ways 23519483 and 23520880.

Project owner annotated Panganiban Drive atlas images and approved coordinated signal logic (2026-10-01), image 2: Ninoy and Cory Avenue and the slightly offset Palomares Street approach share one controller. Position is the shared OSM road vertex of ways 23519483, 836685805 and 23520484; linked_junctions identifies the Palomares vertex on way 836685805.

Project owner annotated Panganiban Drive atlas images (2026-10-01), image 3: Mayon Avenue junction east of Seton Road, north of the railway. Position is the shared OSM road vertex of ways 836685800 and 23522098.

remove.source: Project owner annotated atlas image (2026-10-01): retain downtown traffic lights only at Elias Angeles/Arana (OSM node 254716165) and Elias Angeles/P. Burgos (OSM node 254715532); remove the other locations.
